sourceApp: Native Pimi apps with controlled local demonstration data

mobile.name: Pimi
mobile.declaration: Only the Mac emulator title bar was cropped. The real Android status bar, application UI and navigation bar remain unchanged. No desktop masks or invented phone chrome were applied.

declaration: Actual app captures. Only OS sharing/cursor overlay pixels in the documented top strips were replaced with actual renderer pixels. No app UI was painted, no scaling/sharpening/color filters were applied. JPEG sources remain originally lossy; lossless WebP preserves their decoded pixels after the documented OS cleanup. Original ICC color profiles are preserved; other original metadata is not republished.
